kieler-probes/structure/probe-reference-: KIELER crashes in StructuralDepthJoinProcessor.isInSurface when it cures the schizophrenic fork around a referenced chart whose re-entered superstate holds a state without node (S-15a); the engine does not model that cure's surface search yet and accepts the chart. The same without a contract: structure/probe-index-call-member-target. Found by a review of the written schedules.
kieler-probes/structure/probe-index-call: A short method of a class called in the index of a member array that is assigned (`d.a[c.get()] = 3`): KIELER drops the method and keeps the call, gcc fails; the engine accepts. A method of the chart in that place, a plain array target and a read are fine in both (probe-index-call-*). Found by a review of the written schedules.
